items.headline: Public meeting to scope environmental review for Oakmead Parkway housing project
items.summary: A joint meeting of the City Council, Heritage Preservation Commission, and Planning Commission is scheduled to gather public input on the scope of the environmental review for the proposed residential project at 1250 Oakmead Parkway.

items.headline: Astera Labs permitted for $2.9M office buildout
items.summary: A tenant improvement permit worth $2.9 million was issued for Astera Labs' space at 2315 N 1st St, one of the larger commercial permits in this batch.

items.headline: Qamaria Yemeni Coffee cleared for Stevens Creek buildout
items.summary: A $775,600 tenant improvement permit was issued for a Qamaria Yemeni Coffee location at 2880 Stevens Creek Bl, signaling a new café is coming to that stretch.
